svg.title: F20-8 Records that close the fire scope: who signs each record
svg.text: F20-8 Records that close the fire scope: who signs each record
11 close-out records · contractor signs 10, CxA signs 9 · Dinas signs the fire pump record and issues the recommendation · the Dinas recommendation is an input to the SLF
• The matrix has 11 records; the Dinas alone signs the Damkar recommendation.
• The contractor and the fire control room sign the disablement log.
• The clean agent acceptance file carries the insurer signature and the NFPA 72 record of completion carries the owner signature.
